How I feel for you!

Happy birthday, my love, Zeenat. ❤️

If I could give you one thing in this world, it would be the ability to see yourself through my eyes. Maybe then you would understand how incredibly special you are to me. You bring a kind of happiness into my life that words can never fully explain. No matter how far apart we are, you always have a special place in my heart that nobody else could ever fill. I hope this year brings you all the happiness, love, and beautiful moments you deserve. I love you more than you know.

Reasons I love you 💕

    Missing you 🥺

    Sometimes I wish I could just close my eyes and find myself beside you. No screens, no distance, no waiting for the next call. Just you and me, holding each other and talking about absolutely nothing. Until that day comes, please remember that a part of my heart is always with you, no matter how many miles separate us.
